title: FBI-UAP-D012, Newark Field Office, 1952-1967
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI Newark Field Office reports regarding UAP sightings and investigations from 1952 to 1967, containing several specific encounter reports.

encounters.summary: John H. Riley and George J. Stock observed and photographed a grey, 30-foot diameter saucer with a dome and retractable antenna hovering 200 feet above the ground.
encounters.entity_appearance: greyish disk, 30 feet in diameter, large dome, antenna
encounters.entity_behavior: hovered, tilted to observe ground, antenna darted out and was withdrawn
encounters.quote: As it drew nearer it came to a complete stop and hovered overhead for several moments

encounters.summary: Gary T. Wilcox reported an encounter with an egg-shaped craft and two small beings in silver uniforms in his pasture.
encounters.entity_appearance: two small men, 2 feet tall, silver uniforms and hoods
encounters.quote: I know what I saw for two hours. I was talking with them and even joking with them

encounters.summary: Charles Cozens claimed to have touched the antenna of a glowing flying ship, resulting in a burn on his hand.
encounters.entity_appearance: ship 8-9 feet high, 4 feet wide, 10 feet long, four legs, antenna
physical_effects: two-inch yellowish burn mark on hand
encounters.quote: When he touched the antenna, a flash of electricity occurred and the ship took off

encounters.summary: Peter M. Mackevich, age 11, observed an inverted saucer-shaped object with a turret hovering 10-12 feet above the ground and took two photographs.
encounters.entity_appearance: inverted saucer, 25 feet in diameter, turret on top
encounters.quote: shaped like an inverted saucer approximately twenty-five feet in diameter with a turret on the top surface
